messages.text: I’m checking the analysis pipeline’s model-freeze boundary and whether the full bootstrap repeats tuning, refitting, and closure within the fixed sample roles.

**ECAL-HIGHSTAT-PHYSVAL-ANALYSIS**, reviewed **ab753ec5cea60627e4b09133689b0f27441abf84**.

**[P2] Freeze and enforce feature semantics before loading validation arrays.** [highstat_analysis.py]([redacted] validates artifact hashes but does not compare feature names or extractor/recipe/helper hashes across batches or against frozen training receipts. A validation batch regenerated with a different feature definition can therefore pass these guards. Record a training feature-semantics signature and require it for every validation receipt before opening its NPZ.

Otherwise, the reviewed implementation is consistent with the protocol:

- Model/core/campaign/training-artifact checks precede validation loading.
- Full bootstrap resamples independently within 70k/15k/15k roles and repeats preprocessing, knot construction, tuning, 85k refitting and closure.
- Validation multiplicities are shared across all six series. Historical-model uncertainty is explicitly conditioned on.
- Raw tails/RMS use the declared training-only scale comparator.

Actual non-fitting checks passed:

- All **840 grouped mean/CV/tail/RMS fields** matched explicit duplicated populations.
- Global/η/φ/energy indexing correctly spans **35 columns**.
- **120-width/60-contrast** ordering reproduces \(A\Sigma A^\mathsf{T}\).
- Within-role bootstrap counts remain exactly **70k/15k/15k**.
- Assigned hashes and Python syntax checked.

The 120-width covariance is structurally singular—rank at most **80**—because global closure leaves pre/post CVs identical. Report this as an expected property.

No fits, simulation, ROOT reads, validation-performance inspection or writes. Final numerical results and realized provenance still require review after the feature-semantics guard is addressed.
